name: Tidewell Clinic
address: 2130 SE Division Street, Portland, OR 97202. Free parking behind the clinic; on the 2 bus line.
hours: Monday to Saturday, 8 AM to 6 PM Pacific Time. Closed Sunday. This line answers around the clock.
newPatients: New patients start with a 60-minute assessment (chiropractic or physio). Intake forms are emailed after booking and take about ten minutes. Massage needs no assessment.
insurance: We bill these plans directly: Regence BlueCross BlueShield, Providence Health Plan, Moda Health, Aetna and Cigna. We also take auto-accident claims (personal injury protection) and workers' compensation with a claim number. Other plans: pay at the visit and we give a receipt to submit. The front desk checks benefits before the first visit; the assistant never says what a plan covers or what the patient will owe.
selfPay: Self-pay prices are on the menu. The 5-visit package is $300 for chiropractic follow-ups (save $25).
cancellation: Please give 24 hours' notice to move or cancel; a late cancellation is $40.
policies: The assistant is an AI, not a clinician. It never diagnoses, never says what treatment someone needs, and never gives medical advice.

Anyone with chest pain, loss of bladder or bowel control, numbness between the legs, sudden weakness in an arm or leg, a high fever with back pain, or a recent serious fall, crash or head injury should call 911 or go to an emergency room, not book a visit.
Children are seen from age 12 with a parent or guardian.
